data.body: **[P1] Abort batches when a plugin fatal is already present.** `pluginFatal` is consulted only inside the exception path. If another hook reports a fatal while a synchronous START checkpoint is queued, `checkpointBatch` returns normally because execution is already complete, and this batcher then completes the skipped request successfully. An `AT_MOST_ONCE` step can consequently run its user function even though its START was never persisted and the invocation is already failing. Check `pluginFatal` before and after `executeBatch`, fail current and pending items before normal completion, and add a concurrent fatal/queued-START regression test.
